'''Katrin Böhning-Gaese''' (born 22 December 1964) is a German [[biologist]] who specialises in [[ornithology]]. She is currently a professor at [[Goethe University Frankfurt]], director of the [[Senckenberg Nature Research Society]] and Vice-President of the [[Leibniz Association]].<ref name="www.leopoldina.org">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/8127/|title=Mitglieder|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de|access-date=4 October 2019}}</ref><ref name="www.bik-f.de">{{Cite web|url=http://www.bik-f.de/root/index.php?page_id=256|title=Biodiversität und Klima – Forschungszentrum {{!}} Personen {{!}} Mitarbeiterseiten {{!}} Prof. Dr. Katrin Böhning-Gaese|website=www.bik-f.de|language=de|access-date=4 October 2019}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Katrin Böhning-Gaese was born on 22 December 1964 in [[Oberkochen]], Germany. She initially studied biology as an undergraduate at the [[University of Tübingen]]. She gained her PhD in 1993 from the same University on following research into of [[white stork]] food ecology in [[Upper Swabia]] and causes of long-term stock development in European and North American [[songbird]]s.<ref name="www.leopoldina.org" /> She held the title of Professor of ecology at the [[Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz]] in 2001.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.uni-mainz.de/downloads_presse/FOMA_2008-1_Jahrgang24.pdf | title=Biologische Vielfalt in Ostafrika:Folgen von Landnutzung und Klimawandel | language=de | work=Natur & Geist: Forschungsmagazin | year=2008 | issue=1 | page=73 | accessdate=29 August 2020 | archive-date=7 May 2021 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210507115102/https://www.uni-mainz.de/downloads_presse/FOMA_2008-1_Jahrgang24.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref>

Her main research interests include the influence of global [[climate change]] and human [[land use]] change on animal populations in tropical and [[Temperate climate|temperate]] areas of the world and evolution of bird communities and [[bird migration]].<ref name="www.bik-f.de" /> In addition to research work she also teaches students in the MSc Ecology and Evolution and BSc Biology courses at [[Goethe University Frankfurt]] since 2010.<ref name="www.bik-f.de" />

==Other activities==
* German Council for Sustainable Development (RNE), Member (since 2023, appointed ad personam by [[Chancellor of Germany|Chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]])<ref>[https://www.nachhaltigkeitsrat.de/aktuelles/bundeskanzler-beruft-neuen-rat-fuer-nachhaltige-entwicklung/ Bundeskanzler beruft neuen Rat für Nachhaltige Entwicklung] German Council for Sustainable Development (RNE), press release of 18 January 2023</ref>
* [[Leibniz Association]], Vice-President (since 2017)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de/ueber-uns/organisation/organe.html|title=Organe|website=www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de|access-date=4 October 2019}}</ref>
* Senckenberg Nature Museum, Member of the Governing Board<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fr.de/frankfurt/dinosaurier-suchen-anfaenger-frankfurt-13032911.html|title=Dinosaurier suchen für Anfänger in Frankfurt|date=23 September 2019|access-date=4 October 2019}}</ref>
